## User-visible change / 用户会看到什么变化

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. / 说明问题和改动后的实际行为。

## Verification / 怎样验证

List relevant checks and observed results, including skipped or unexecuted checks. For a defense change, include an allowed task and an unwanted action. / 列出相关检查与实际结果，区分跳过和未执行项；防护改动请同时说明正常任务和要阻止的操作。

## Limits / 仍有哪些限制

State remaining failures, supported versions and any unreleased dependency. / 说明仍存在的问题、已验证版本以及尚未发布的依赖。

See [contribution notes](https://github.com/yh-l20/agentsec/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md). / 参阅贡献说明。
